logp.method_description: The lipophilicity (log P) of the compounds was determined using the shake-flask method [20]. At first, aqueous (0.9 % w/v) sodium chloride and organic (n-octanol) phases were saturated for 1 week. The platinum(II) compounds (1–4) were dissolved at the concentration of 0.30 mg mL-1 in 2.5 mL of the aqueous phase. An equal volume of saturated n-octanol was added and the solutions were stirred mechanically in plastic tubes for 30 min. The samples were centrifuged (6000 rpm, 15 min). After separation, the phases were analyzed by UV–vis spectroscopy to determine the amount of the compounds in each phase. In the next step, based on the Lambert–Beer Law, the partition coefficient between two phases for each compound was calculated to determine the log P values. For each compound (1–4), the procedures were repeated fivefold.
